atAGlance: Nghêu xào bơ tỏi is clams stir-fried in garlic-butter sauce. It is briny, rich, aromatic, and best while the shells are still hot.
whatItIs: Nghêu xào bơ tỏi are clams stir-fried with butter and garlic, often rich, fragrant, and a little sweet from the shellfish juices.
howToEnjoy: Scoop the butter-garlic juices with bread or rice if offered, and leave any clam that stays closed. The garlic should be fragrant, not harsh.
howLocalsOrder: Order nghêu xào bơ tỏi when you want a richer clam plate. Ask for less chili or extra bread before the clams arrive.
worthKnowing: Bơ tỏi means butter-garlic, a popular ốc-shop flavor that is different from fish-sauce stir-fry seasoning.
goodToKnow: Bơ tỏi means butter-garlic. Expect sweet clam juices, toasted garlic, and richness from butter rather than the sharper fish-sauce profile of other seafood plates.
travelerCaution: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
